subjective.text: Jack Smith has been experiencing hearing problems for about six weeks with difficulty hearing from his left ear.
Jack Smith occasionally experiences ringing in his left ear and feels dizzy at times.
Jack Smith has not had any pain from the ear nor discharge coming out of it during this period.
Jack Smith does not use cotton ball buds to clean his ears.

objective.text: Dr. Mesa examined Jack's ear and found no physical blockage but recommended a face-to-face appointment for further evaluation.

assessment.text: Jack Smith has hearing problems in his left ear with ringing and occasional dizziness without pain or discharge.

plan.text: Dr. Mesa recommended a face-to-face appointment within the next four to five days for further evaluation of Jack's ear.
Dr. Mesa advised Jack to read about Tinnitus and suggested providing him with a link to a leaflet on Tinnitus in his appointment notes.
Dr. Mesa scheduled another GP for the face-to-face appointment and provided contact information for support team if needed between now and then.
